reason: The after source supports CHARBOUND and STRIPCC together, but the fixed harness has no call or call sequence that reaches their combined boundary-marker behavior. The same behavior was unsupported before the change, so this coverage gap is introduced.
finite_witness: Input bytes 61 c2 90 62 00 (a, U+0090, b, NUL), size 5. A supported utf8proc_map call with CHARBOUND | STRIPCC would retain markers before a and b and remove the marker before the stripped control. The harness accepts these bytes but never makes that call.

coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The harness uses STRIPCC in direct UTF-32 normalization and CHARBOUND in separate map calls; each map call takes the original input.
